name: sertao-fight-brasil-mobile
description: App de celular (Android e iOS) do Sertão Fight Brasil, empacotado com Capacitor a partir do jogo web.
author: Vinícius Andrey

scripts.sync: npm run sync:web && cap sync && node scripts/patch-native.js
scripts.android:debug: npm run sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.android:release: npm run sync && cd android && ./gradlew bundleRelease
scripts.ios:open: npm run sync && cap open ios
